# Alpha 多样性分析

## 目的

比较不同处理组在各时间点的肠道菌群 Alpha 多样性（Shannon 指数），评估饮食处理对菌群多样性的影响。

## 方法

- **多样性指数**：Shannon 指数，同时考虑物种丰富度和均匀度
- **统计检验**：Wilcoxon 秩和检验
- **可视化**：箱线图 + 散点，按时间点分面

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: "Shannon Alpha Diversity"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

suppressWarnings(library(tidyverse))
suppressWarnings(library(readxl))

# 读取数据
df <- read_excel("fig1d.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")

# 数据处理：固定分组顺序
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Day = factor(Day, levels = c("Day 0", "Day 28")),
    Diet = factor(Diet, levels = c("CON", "LM"))
  )

# 绘图：箱线图 + 散点
ggplot(df, aes(x = Diet, y = shannon)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Day),
    width = 0.2,
    size = 3,
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Day, nrow = 1, ncol = 2, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Day 0" = "#E67373", "Day 28" = "#40B8A0")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Shannon diversity",
    limits = c(2, 5.5),
    breaks = c(3, 4, 5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5, y = 5.2,
    label = "Wilcoxon, P = 0.77",
    size = 5,
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 3.5, y = 5.2,
    label = "Wilcoxon, P = 0.002",
    size = 5,
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )
```

## 结果解读

- **Day 0**（左图）：P = 0.77，说明实验开始前 CON 和 LM 两组的 Shannon 多样性无显著差异，基线可比
- **Day 28**（右图）：P = 0.002，说明经过 28 天处理后，两组的 Shannon 多样性存在显著差异
- Shannon 指数越高，表示菌群多样性越高（物种越丰富且分布越均匀）
- 结果提示 LM 饮食处理可能改变了肠道菌群的多样性水平
